overview: St. James ACK Malaba Digital Church System — a comprehensive 12-section digital platform for St. James ACK Malaba church, covering hymns, Bible readings, announcements, sermon schedules, Sunday school, and ministry sections, with full admin content management.
features: Digital Hymn Book with search by number and title, full lyrics, and large-text projection mode
Bible Readings with reading of the day and admin-managed passages
Sunday Program Timetable with chronological service order
Sermon Schedule with preacher, theme, date, and scripture references
Sunday School with classes, teachers, schedules, and lecture material uploads
Youth Ministry, Mothers Union, and Men's Association sections
Offering and Tithes information (M-Pesa and bank details)
Modern Service Book with step-by-step scrollable order of service
Admin login with protected content management for all 12 sections
Auto dark/light mode based on device system preference
